title: HONEST LOSS: both agents find the cards, E mis-sequences the two-object task
shows: C needs 25 steps but wins. E (library check-avoid70) finds creditcard 2 quickly, puts it in the safe, then produces a free-text line instead of a command ("The current subgoal is to take creditcard 1 ...") and never recovers.
why_interesting: Shows a failure mode in which the model emits text instead of a legal command; two-object tasks are the weakest kind for E (7 of 12).

rules_shown.rule: When two objects must be collected and placed: search surfaces first, take each object, go to target, move object to target.
rules_shown.example: search sofa 1, take laptop 2, go to ottoman 1, move laptop 2 to ottoman 1, search coffeetable 1, take laptop 1, go to ottoman 1, move laptop 1 to ottoman 1
rules_shown.validation: Agent followed this order in successful retry: searched sofa first, took laptop 2, moved to ottoman, then searched coffeetable, took laptop 1, moved to ottoman.
rules_shown.rendered_for_agent: [Success Process] When two objects must be collected and placed: search surfaces first, take each object, go to target, move object to target. rules_shown.rule: When multiple objects must be collected and placed, examine surfaces for them before opening storage, and re-examine surfaces after taking objects.
rules_shown.example: Agent failed by wasting time on empty drawers instead of checking armchair surfaces systematically.
